mapper.select: SELECT log.ID, log.JOB_ID, log.JOB_SEQ, log.JOB_NAME, log.END_DATE, log.START_DATE, log.EXEC_DATE, log.LASTEXEC_DATE, log.FLAG, log.EXEC_DETAIL, log.EXEC_STATUS, log.STATUS, log.EXEC_RESULT, log.EXEC_FLAG, job.RULE_ID, job.ISPRODRELATED isProdRelated, info.REPORT_CATEGORY FROM REP_INSTALL_LOG log LEFT JOIN REP_JOB job on log.JOB_ID = job.JOB_ID left join rep_rule rule on rule.ID = job.RULE_ID left join rep_info info on info.REP_ID = rule.REP_ID and info.REPORT_TYPE='Y' WHERE EXEC_STATUS = #{execStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND STATUS = 'E' AND EXEC_FLAG !=#{execFlag, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select nvl(max(id),0) from ADPT_MAINTHREADRECORD where SOURCEID = #{sourceid}
SELECT to_char(DATA_DATE) FROM ADPT_ZG_TO_ODS T WHERE T.DATA_DATE = (SELECT MAX(S.DATA_DATE) FROM ADPT_ZG_TO_ODS S)
select sta.ID, sta.SOURID, sta.PRODID, sta.STATUS from REP_BATCH_DATE_STATUS sta where sta.ID =( select nvl(max(id),0) from REP_BATCH_DATE_STATUS where SOURID = #{sourceid})

select count(1) from adpt_interfaceparamslastmax a where a.lastvalstr = #{execDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and cfgid in (select id from adpt_interfacecolconfig where interfacesourceid = #{execflag, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and coltype=12)
select count(1) from ADPT_FILEBACKUPRECORD where sourceid=#{execflag, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and fromfilepath like '%' || #{execDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
